subtitle: Business-to-technology blueprint for asset-liability management, IRRBB, funds transfer pricing, and liquidity risk on Teradata FSDM

stakeholders.interest: Balance-sheet structure, NII defense, FTP policy, rate risk, liquidity buffers
Budget NII, FTP-adjusted profitability, capital allocation, hedge accounting
IRRBB, EVE, delta-NII, stress scenarios, model validation

valueChain.name: Golden Instrument Position
valueChain.description: Reconcile every on/off-balance-sheet position from Sierra and CBS into a single instrument record with classification, repricing and GL tagging.

valueChain.name: Cashflow Generation
valueChain.description: Generate contractual and behavioral cashflows from principal, coupon, redemption and early-termination schedules.

valueChain.name: FTP & Transfer Pricing
valueChain.description: Assign matched-maturity transfer rates, liquidity and option spreads to isolate business-line margin from rate and liquidity risk.

valueChain.name: Repricing & IRRBB
valueChain.description: Bucket rate-sensitive assets and liabilities, compute EVE and delta-NII under SBP/Basel rate shocks.

valueChain.name: Liquidity & LCR/NSFR
valueChain.description: Ladder cashflows, apply run-offs and HQLA haircuts to compute Basel III liquidity ratios and stress survival.

valueChain.name: ALCO Decision Support
valueChain.description: Consolidate risk metrics, profitability and regulatory KPIs into ALCO packs, scenario analysis and limit monitoring.

useCases.title: Golden Instrument Position Feed
useCases.objective: Build a single reconciled position feed for ALM, FTP, liquidity and risk so every downstream engine uses the same numbers.
useCases.businessValue: Eliminates spreadsheet stitching and reconciliation errors in ALCO; reduces ALM production time by 50%.
useCases.kpiTarget: 95% of positions auto-reconciled daily by month 6

useCases.title: Matched-Maturity Funds Transfer Pricing
useCases.objective: Assign FTP to every asset and liability to isolate business-line margin from rate and liquidity risk.
useCases.businessValue: Reveals true product profitability; enables pricing discipline and protects NII by moving rate risk to Treasury.
useCases.kpiTarget: FTP applied to 100% of balance sheet by month 6

useCases.title: Repricing Gap & IRRBB (EVE / NII)
useCases.objective: Quantify rate risk in the banking book through EVE and delta-NII under SBP and internal rate shocks.
useCases.businessValue: Ensures capital adequacy, supports ALCO hedging decisions and satisfies Basel IRRBB expectations.
useCases.kpiTarget: EVE sensitivity within board limits under +/-200 bps shock

useCases.title: Basel III LCR & NSFR Automation
useCases.objective: Compute daily LCR and NSFR from the same cashflow ladder used for ALM and profitability.
useCases.businessValue: Reduces regulatory reporting cycle from days to hours; improves liquidity risk visibility.
useCases.kpiTarget: LCR and NSFR >100% with 5-day trend alerts

useCases.title: CASA Behavioral Modeling (NMD)
useCases.objective: Model core/volatile split, decay and rate beta for non-maturing deposits to improve FTP, liquidity and IRRBB.
useCases.businessValue: Avoids overstating liquidity and rate risk from overnight CASA treatment; improves deposit franchise valuation.
useCases.kpiTarget: NMD model approved for IRRBB and FTP by month 12

useCases.title: Islamic Profitability & Rate Treatment
useCases.objective: Separate Islamic P&L, profit-rate benchmark and FTP for mudarabah/murabaha/ijarah instruments.
useCases.businessValue: Supports Shariah-compliant reporting and ensures Islamic products are priced on true funding cost.
useCases.kpiTarget: Islamic book FTP and profitability reported separately by month 18

useCases.title: IFRS 9 ECL on Shared Cashflows
useCases.objective: Stage exposures and compute ECL using the same cashflow engine that feeds ALM and profitability.
useCases.businessValue: Removes ECL/ALM reconciliation breaks and provides consistent risk-adjusted profitability.
useCases.kpiTarget: ECL and ALM cashflows reconcile to within 1% by month 18

useCases.title: ALCO Scenario & What-If Analysis
useCases.objective: Enable ALCO to model rate, liquidity, funding-mix and product-growth scenarios in real time.
useCases.businessValue: Improves balance-sheet decision-making and capital allocation under uncertainty.
useCases.kpiTarget: Scenario results generated in <5 minutes by month 18
